IC1: 1. Hospitalized in an eligible medical ICU
IC2: 2. Age ≥ 18 years old at the time of hospitalization
IC3: 3. With sepsis as defined by the Sepsis-3 (2016) consensus as a known [OR] or suspected infection [AND] with a SOFA score of ≥2 points above baseline
IC4: 4. Received broad-spectrum antibiotics within the last 24 hours [OR] or ordered and pending administration
IC5: 5. Able to complete enrollment within 4 hours of ICU admission for administration of the intervention within 6 hours of ICU admission
